newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures market stands still.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures market stands still.

text.p: Australian wheat futures did not trade on Monday although the market remained firm.
Settlement prices for most contracts rose by A$1.00-A$2.00 a tonne, although the two nearest contracts, March and May 1997, both edged back by A$1.00 a tonne to A$171.00 and A$172.00 respectively.
This continued Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat's performance of holding out against Chicago's fall.
Phil Lindsay of Ord Minnett Jardine Fleming Futures Ltd said he had orders but eventually nobody was willing to trade. Growers had committed most of their wheat to the AWB pool.
